name: TextBox 5
text:
Vertex Group delivers integrated electrical and automation EPC solutions for India's heavy industry through two specialist companies.

VERTEX POWER CONTROLS PVT. LTD. (Est. 2006) — MV/LV Panel Board Manufacturing, High-Voltage Substation EPC up to 132 kV, Protection and Relay Systems, Substations Automation. Authorized Channel Partner of Siemens Ltd. for MV Switchgear and SAS.

Track Record: 132 kV Substation EPC for a Integrated Steel Plant (Pacific Iron Manufacturing Ltd.), DISCOM Substation under India's IPDS scheme (DVVNL), and a 30 km hill-terrain transmission line for UPCL in Uttarakhand. 20+ years of continuous operations.

VERTEX AUTOMATION SYSTEMS PVT. LTD. (Est. 2004) — Factory Automation and System Integration: PLC, HMI, SCADA, VFD, Servo Drives, Industrial Robotics, and Special Purpose Machine (SPM) Manufacturing. The group's defining capability: both disciplines — Power Infrastructure and Automation Control. Most Industrial Projects manage these as two separate vendor relationships and absorb the integration risk. Vertex removes that gap.
